text:
marco: hey folks — my docs PR is blocked by CODEOWNERS requiring two approvals from @eng and @sdk, but it only touches `docs/sdk/quickstart.md` and an example snippet. Is there a fast path?
ellie: can you paste the PR link? sometimes path globs catch more than expected.
marco: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/1234 — small fixes and a tiny snippet update to the SDK README. CI shows docs-preview failed.
shaun: from eng-infra — we updated CODEOWNERS last week so any change under `sdk/` requires @eng-team approval because snippets run a validation harness. That said, purely markdown tweaks can use the docs-only bypass if you follow the label flow.
marco: i tried adding `#docs-only` label but auto-merge still blocked by `docs-preview` job failing with an external link timeout.
ci-bot: docs-preview — failed — `html-proofer`: External link `https://example.com/sdk-sample` timed out after 30s
ellie: ah, the preview runner blocks network calls by default. For snippets that hit external APIs we either mock them or set `allow_network: true` in the preview config — but the latter is gated.
shaun: options: 1) move runnable example to `examples/` and reference it (owners differ), 2) change preview config to `docs/.preview/config.yml` with `mock_external: true`, or 3) request infra to temporarily relax the CODEOWNERS requirement for this PR.
lena: product is fine with a one-off manual approval for doc fixes that don't change API surface.
prashant: i can review the content now. If it's docs-only, can an eng approver click approve so CODEOWNERS is satisfied?
ellie: small note: auto-merge also requires branch protection settings: if "Require status checks to pass" is on, all required checks must pass before auto-merge triggers. Label bypass only skips some checks but not CODEOWNERS approvals.
shaun: i'm going to add a temporary label workflow: adding `#docs-ci-bypass` will skip link checks for confirmed docs-only PRs. Doing it now.
deploy-bot: Label added: #docs-ci-bypass by shaun at 1795012378
marco: added label, pushed a tiny commit to re-run checks — thanks. Who can approve?
prashant: LGTM, approving now.
ellie: reviewed, approved.
ci-bot: docs-preview check re-run — passed (html-proofer: 0 failures)
deploy-bot: PR merged by auto-merge (maintainer) at 1795012599
marco: huge thanks all :raised_hands: will open a follow-up to reduce flakiness in the preview job.
shaun: noted: INFRA-3421 created to adjust preview runner timeouts and add a `mock_external` opt-in for snippet-heavy docs.
ellie: i'll add a short section in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md explaining when to use `#docs-ci-bypass` vs asking for manual approval.
marco: closing the thread — appreciate the quick turnaround!
